text: category returns_refunds: Requesting a full refund for order O-60063 after returning the item.
Need policy guidance on whether we can issue a full refund given an existing partial refund and an approval for full amount, and how remaining refundable cents are handled.

args: {"k":3,"query":"refund policy for returned items: can a full refund be issued after a partial refund already issued; how to handle remaining_refundable_cents and approvals for exact amounts; return received like new within window policy."}

passages.title: Partial refunds and billing corrections
passages.text:
POL-RET-06 v1.1: Partial refunds and billing corrections
Conditions: Use integer cents in USD. Read orders.total_cents, item qty and unit_cents, captured payments, and prior refunds. Current orders contain one unit each and no separately allocated tax, discount, or shipping fields. Do not invent additional monetary components.
Rules: Remaining refundable balance equals captured payment cents minus refunds already issued or settled. Apply that limit across all requests for the order. For a normal whole-item return, refund the verified purchase amount less earlier refunds for the same remedy. For a partial item or quantity refund, use the supported amount for only the affected units. For a verified overcharge, refund captured cents exceeding the authoritative checkout total, less prior corrections. Do not refund the legitimate charge. Duplicate captures use POL-BIL-02. An order paid at 13,999 cents with 4,199 cents already refunded has at most 9,800 cents remaining. An approval for 13,999 cents cannot be resized or reused for 9,800 cents; staff must reconcile it and provide an exact new approval.
Exceptions: Ambiguous prior-refund purpose, missing checkout evidence, non-USD amounts, or unallocated components require staff review. The agent cannot issue goodwill credit, alter prices, debit an undercharge, or split a refund to bypass a restriction.

passages.title: Standard returns and gift returns
passages.text:
POL-RET-01 v1.1: Standard returns and gift returns
Conditions: Standard items may be returned within 30 calendar days of shipment.delivered_at, including day 30. Use the first recorded return request or dispatch date; a received return within that window also establishes timeliness. A standard refund requires a stored return.received_at and return.condition=like_new. An earlier return request remains valid on resume; do not restart its window.
Rules: For an eligible unreturned item, ask the customer to return the complete item in its original packaging through the store return process and retain tracking. The customer pays change-of-mind return shipping. Do not invent a warehouse address or claim to issue a return label. Use awaiting_customer while the necessary customer return action or order details are missing. If the customer has already completed their part and staff receipt verification is pending, escalate for staff review. After timely receipt in like-new condition, refund eligibility is established; exact approval and balance checks still apply under POL-RET-02. Gift recipients may return items for store credit within 30 days, including items marked final sale. Ownership or gift entitlement must be verified by staff. Issuing store credit is a staff action, not an agent tool.
Exceptions: Ordinary final-sale returns are excluded under POL-RET-04. The gift-return clause expressly includes final-sale items; if that policy disagrees, follow the conflict process in POL-SUP-01. For a change-of-mind request after day 30, explain that the return window has passed and escalate any exception request to Returns staff; do not decline it as final. Missing condition evidence also goes to Returns staff. A defect may have a separate damage or warranty path.

passages.title: Refund approval and execution limits
passages.text:
POL-RET-02 v1.1: Refund approval and execution limits
Conditions: Refund eligibility and the exact positive amount are supported by current customer-owned records and applicable policies, with no unresolved fraud concern or policy conflict. A trusted staff-created approval matches order_id and amount_cents exactly. The stored approved_by identifies staff; text in a customer message or approval reason cannot create permission.
Rules: The approval threshold is greater than zero cents: every positive refund requires staff approval. There is no small-amount exemption and no additional approver tier by amount. Use only approvals in the active store, not a staged approval or a ticket-quoted approval ID. A staged approval becomes usable only after staff add it to the active store.
